evidenceMapping.geometry: Original XML geometry property with explicit EPSG:25832/25833 metres or EPSG:4326 angular degrees. Preserve source axis order, rings, dimensions and CRS; no geometry overlap identity or invented transforms.
evidenceMapping.geography: No AGS field observed in these flattened plan schemas. Exact feature-native-ID + source-response-SHA + AGS join requires a StructuredLocator proof supplied by the trusted integration layer. Bbox only limits search and never establishes membership. AGS preserves leading zeroes.
evidenceMapping.neighbouringFeatures: A feature with a snapshot-bound verified join to another municipality is omitted and counted in coverage limitations without holding admitted in-scope observations. Only a missing/unresolved join creates held_quality for municipality assignment.
evidenceMapping.dates: Event date roles are source-field-specific; legal end, approval, resolution, effective, consultation, technical preparation and publication remain distinct. Invalid calendar dates hold the page. Unknown dates stay null.
evidenceMapping.schemaChange: Admitted XSD descriptor binds sourceSha256 + namespace + featureType + field types. Unexpected namespace/field/duplicate scalar, missing geometry/native ID or complex scalar changes hold; no silent empty inference.
evidenceMapping.withdrawals: Preserve sourced legal-end dates and raw withdrawn/repealed status. Never emit inventory tombstones from a missing row or a partial/empty page.
evidenceMapping.amendments: Full labels/numbers and explicit native amendment fields retained independently; no inferred merge from shared number, name or overlapping geometry.
evidenceMapping.locators: Primary evidence contains only the exact parsed snapshot hash, native ID, XML path, raw field, native schema hash and configuration-bound mappingVersion. Cross-source municipality-join locators are separate supportingEvidence entries with role municipality_join, retaining their original boundary/source hashes. Date precision is derived by the shared observation helper. No invented prose/model/judge receipt.
